question: Who among the following is the author of the novel 'Untouchable'?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Mulk Raj Anand**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Mulk Raj Anand** is the author of the novel 'Untouchable'.
 
• He was an Indian writer in English, notable for his depiction of the lives of the poorer castes in traditional Indian society.
 
• 'Untouchable' was published in 1935 and is considered one of his most famous works.
 
• The novel deals with the social injustice and discrimination faced by the untouchables in India.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Mulk Raj Anand** was born on 12th December 1905 and passed away on 28th September 2004.
 
• He was among the first India-based writers in English to gain an international readership.
 
• His literary work includes novels, short stories, and essays, and he is considered a pioneer of the Indian-English novel.
 
• Other notable works by Mulk Raj Anand include 'Coolie', 'Two Leaves and a Bud', and 'The Village'.
 
• Anand's contribution to Indian literature is significant, and he is often referred to as the Charles Dickens of India.
